# Parmesan Taters

> [!tip] Imported Recipe
> This recipe is a favorite of a local doctor that was printed in our town newspaper back in 1989. If made in extra small pieces, it makes a great appetizer or hors d'oeuvre. Larger sized pieces of potato make the perfect side dish tor most any entree.

## 🥘 Ingredients
- [ ] 1/2  cup    flour
- [ ] 1/2  cup    parmesan cheese, grated
- [ ] 1/2  teaspoon    salt
- [ ] 1/4  teaspoon    pepper
- [ ] 2 -3   lbs    potatoes
- [ ] 1/2  cup    butter

## 🍳 Instructions
1. Cut potatoes into wedges or slices, depending on size desired. You may leave skins on or peel them.
2. Mix flour and Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper in a plastic bag.
3. Add potato pieces to bag and shake to cover all surfaces.
4. Melt butter in a 9 x 13 baking pan.
5. Place potatoes in baking pan.
6. Bake at 350* for 60 minutes. Turn once at 30 minutes.

## 💡 Notes & Variations
This recipe is a favorite of a local doctor that was printed in our town newspaper back in 1989. If made in extra small pieces, it makes a great appetizer or hors d'oeuvre. Larger sized pieces of potato make the perfect side dish tor most any entree.
